title: Burner Press
description: The &3Presses&r are machines that can be used to make &6Plates&r, &6Wires&r, &6Circuits&r, &6Bullet Casings&r as well as &6Compressing&r non-smeltable powders back into their normal form. They require &6Stamps&r to work, which can be made from an &3Anvil&r.
&2A preheater can be placed next to the Burner Press to increase its speed.
